answer: At each protocol summit a trellis of cryptographic checkpoints is inserted into the reward contract, requiring every new agent to post a ferrous‑signed stake and then earn its payout through a linear vesting schedule. The stake, e.g., 10 tokens, is locked immediately and released only after a 30‑day epoch during which the agent must submit signed liveness proofs each block; any missing proof slashes the stake. An attacker must therefore front‑load 10 tokens per fake identity and wait 30 days before any reward, making a Sybil farm cost 10 tokens + 30‑day delay per identity.
